verdict.rationale: Live egress to RTMP or HLS is a fair question for a real-time video platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only archiving (record, save, retrieve) and SIP interconnect, neither of which is live RTMP/HLS broadcast to a non-participant audience. Recording is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session
